title: Aged
summary: A'GED, adjective 1. Old; having lived long; having lived almost the usual time allotted to that species of being; applied to animals or plants; as, an aged man, or an aged oak. 2. Having a certain age

inlines.v: A'GED, adjective 1. Old; having lived long; having lived almost the usual time allotted to that species of being; applied to animals or plants; as, an aged man, or an aged oak. 2. Having a certain age; having lived; as, a man aged forty years. A'GED, noun Old persons. And the aged arose and stood up. Job 29:8.
